projects.title: Private 5G Campus
projects.blurb: A private 5G campus written so another engineer can review it: the radio, the core, and the enterprise IP it lands on.
highlights: Two slices, two jobs: campus traffic, and the traffic that runs the network
RU, DU, and CU drawn apart, with the interface on each hop named

projects.title: Software-Defined Radio
projects.blurb: The design is checked against a spectrum I capture. RTL-SDR and GNU Radio, receive only, until a license allows transmit.
highlights: A written chain from IQ samples to a decoded signal
Signals identified on the bench, not from a diagram
Transmit stays off until the amateur license is in hand

projects.title: Edge Protocols
projects.blurb: The protocol is a result, not a preference. The same telemetry on MQTT and on CoAP, the latency written down, TCP or UDP named underneath.
highlights: One payload, two protocols, the slower one visible in the numbers
Where each one sits on TCP or UDP, stated, not assumed
ESP32 at the device, broker and consumer in containers

projects.title: Network Operations
projects.blurb: The part already in production. Metrics, logs, and traces on a cluster I operate — the view a cloud-native user plane is watched with.
highlights: Live metrics, logs, and traces on a cluster I run
The same operational habit a cloud-native user plane needs
Open the dashboard and see the pipeline, not a mock

bullets: Banking Systems Integration (Fintech): Development of payment solutions compliant with EMIS standards, implementing secure automatic direct-debit subscription flows to optimize recurring collections.

Corporate File Automation & Generation: Built high-reliability modules for generating and validating standard bank collection files (IDD pacs.003), ensuring accuracy in financial transactions and reducing operational errors.

Digital Workplace Platform: Developed and maintained critical systems integrating advanced institutional calendar modules, K2-based workflows, and real-time internal chat/messaging channels to improve team communication and collaboration.

Infrastructure Efficiency & Monitoring: Connected corporate platforms to advanced audit tooling (logs, metrics, and tracing), improving overall IT ecosystem observability and delivering a 15% increase in global system stability.
System Diagnostics Optimization: Implemented modern distributed tracing and observability tools that cut critical failure debugging and resolution time by 40%, minimizing platform downtime.
Application Performance Engineering: Designed automated, dynamic systems for background task processing directly in the user interface, drastically improving response time and compute resource usage.
Corporate Digital Interfaces: Redesign and development of responsive digital portals and integrated inventory systems, aligning visual identity with international market best practices.

Administrative Process Automation: Built scripts and automated routines for filling internal documentation, eliminating repetitive tasks and increasing productivity for the hospital administrative team.
E-Commerce Platform Development: Construction of user interfaces for e-commerce portals, applying reactive design and ensuring accessibility and a fluid purchase journey.
Visual Experience Enhancement: Implemented dynamic themes (light/dark mode) and modern fast-loading architectures, raising user retention and engagement.

hero.name: PETER MAQUIRAN.
hero.description: I hold a private network as one system. 5G NR and Open RAN on IP, a spectrum I can capture, a device protocol chosen from a measured latency, and an operations view that is already live.

telecom.title: Good at the join.
telecom.description: A private network fails at one join: radio into IP, IP into the device, the device into the dashboard. I work until I can say what that hop carries, what it costs, and how I would see it fail.
